# Command palette (`command-palette`)

Search every command from the keyboard.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createCommandPalette` (types in `dist/web/overlays/commandPalette.d.ts`): `.mh-overlay.mh-palette`: search every command from the keyboard. A modal `<dialog>` near the top of the screenwith a search box (`role="combobox"`) over a `role="listbox"` of commands, grouped under headings until you type,then ranked by how well they match with the matched letters marked. Arrow keys move, Enter runs, Escape closes;the pointer works too. With `hotkey`, Ctrl+K (⌘K) opens it from anywhere. Parts `__panel`, `__search`, `__input`,`__list`, `__group`, `__heading`, `__option`, `__empty`, `__footer`.

```ts
export function createCommandPalette(options: CommandPaletteOptions): CommandPaletteHandle;

export interface CommandPaletteOptions {
  commands: readonly Command[];
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Ctrl+K (⌘K on Apple keyboards) anywhere opens and closes it. Default false. */
  hotkey?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<CommandPaletteLabels>;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  onOpen?: () => void;
  onClose?: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
}

export interface CommandPaletteHandle {
  el: HTMLDialogElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setCommands(commands: readonly Command[]): void;
  /** Closes it and removes the hotkey listener. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface CommandPaletteLabels {
  /** Accessible name of the dialog. */
  label: string;
  placeholder: string;
  /** Accessible name of the list. */
  list: string;
  empty: string;
  move: string;
  run: string;
  close: string;
  /** Spoken when the results change. */
  results: (count: number) => string;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createCommandPalette, h, type Command } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = h('p', { 'aria-live': 'polite' });

const commands: Command[] = [
  { value: 'lights-off', label: 'Turn off all lights', icon: 'lightbulb', group: 'Lights', keywords: ['dark', 'night'] },
  { value: 'lights-on', label: 'Turn on all lights', icon: 'lightbulb-on', group: 'Lights' },
  { value: 'evening', label: 'Evening scene', icon: 'play', group: 'Scenes', description: 'Living room at 40%' },
  { value: 'lock', label: 'Lock the front door', icon: 'lock', group: 'Security', shortcut: 'Ctrl+L' },
  { value: 'heating', label: 'Set heating to 20°', icon: 'thermometer', group: 'Climate', keywords: ['warm'] },
  { value: 'settings', label: 'Open settings', icon: 'settings', group: 'App' },
];

// `hotkey` also opens it with Ctrl+K (⌘K on Apple keyboards).
const palette = createCommandPalette({
  commands,
  hotkey: true,
  onSelect: (value) => (status.textContent = `Ran: ${value}`),
});

const open = createButton({ label: 'Search commands', icon: 'search', onClick: () => palette.open() });

document.body.append(open.el, status);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`CommandPalette` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createCommandPalette` as a component: the web renderer's palette, built in an effect.

```ts
export function CommandPalette({ open, onClose, onOpen, commands, onSelect, hotkey, labels, container }: CommandPaletteProps);

export interface CommandPaletteProps {
  open: boolean;
  /** The user closed it (Escape, a press outside, or running a command); set `open` to false. */
  onClose: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  /** It opened from the hotkey; set `open` to true. */
  onOpen?: () => void;
  commands: readonly Command[];
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
  hotkey?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<CommandPaletteLabels>;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, CommandPalette } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { Command } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const commands: Command[] = [
  { value: 'lights-off', label: 'Turn off all lights', icon: 'lightbulb', group: 'Lights', keywords: ['dark', 'night'] },
  { value: 'lights-on', label: 'Turn on all lights', icon: 'lightbulb-on', group: 'Lights' },
  { value: 'evening', label: 'Evening scene', icon: 'play', group: 'Scenes', description: 'Living room at 40%' },
  { value: 'lock', label: 'Lock the front door', icon: 'lock', group: 'Security', shortcut: 'Ctrl+L' },
  { value: 'heating', label: 'Set heating to 20°', icon: 'thermometer', group: 'Climate', keywords: ['warm'] },
  { value: 'settings', label: 'Open settings', icon: 'settings', group: 'App' },
];

export function CommandPaletteExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [ran, setRan] = useState('');
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="search" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Search commands
      </Button>
      <p aria-live="polite">{ran && `Ran: ${ran}`}</p>
      {/* `hotkey` also opens it with Ctrl+K (⌘K on Apple keyboards). */}
      <CommandPalette
        open={open}
        onOpen={() => setOpen(true)}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        commands={commands}
        hotkey
        onSelect={setRan}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
